parsed.title: Inconsistent guard behavior description
parsed.detail: The 'Turn contract' section states: 'Any blank required input was re-asked once; if still blank the skill emits `→ Next: execute-phase requires manual input — cannot proceed` and stops.' However, the 'Needs-input guard' section (line 68) specifies the same behavior for the `<NN-slug>` input, but the 'Turn contract' implies this is a general rule for *all* required inputs, whereas the 'Needs-input guard' only explicitly defines the requirement and failure mode for `<NN-slug>`. If other required inputs are added later, the contract is ambiguous about whether they follow the 're-ask once' rule.
